    def __init__(self, node_count):
        self.size = node_count
        self.edges_info = []
        self.adjacency = [[] for _ in range(node_count)]

    def connect(self, src, dst, capacity, weight):

        self.edges_info.append((src, len(self.adjacency[src])))
        self.adjacency[src].append(self.Edge(dst, len(self.adjacency[dst]), capacity, weight))
        self.adjacency[dst].append(self.Edge(src, len(self.adjacency[src]) - 1, 0, -weight))
        return idx

    class Link:
        def __init__(self, origin, destination, capacity, flow, weight):
            self.origin = origin
            self.destination = destination
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.weight = weight

    def retrieve_link(self, index):
        source, pos = self.edges_info[index]
        forward = self.adjacency[source][pos]
        backward = self.adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev]
        return self.Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight)

    def all_links(self):
        output = []
        for idx in range(len(self.edges_info)):
            source, pos = self.edges_info[idx]
            forward = self.adjacency[source][pos]
            backward = self.adjacency[forward.destination][forward.rev]
            output.append(self.Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight))
        return output

    def _potential_update(self, source, target):
        self.distances = [4294967295] * self.size
        self.parents = [-1] * self.size
        self.parent_edges = [-1] * self.size
        self.marked = [False] * self.size
        queue = [source]
        self.distances[source] = 0
        while queue:
            current = heapq.heappop(queue) & 4294967295
            if self.marked[current]:
                continue
            self.marked[current] = True
            if current == target:
                break
            for idx in range(len(self.adjacency[current])):
                edge = self.adjacency[current][idx]
                if self.marked[edge.destination] or edge.capacity == 0:
                    continue
                adjusted_cost = edge.weight - self.potential[edge.destination] + self.potential[current]
                if self.distances[edge.destination] > self.distances[current] + adjusted_cost:
                    self.distances[edge.destination] = self.distances[current] + adjusted_cost
                    self.parents[edge.destination] = current
                    self.parent_edges[edge.destination] = idx
                    heapq.heappush(queue, ((self.distances[edge.destination] << 32) + edge.destination))
        if not self.marked[target]:
            return False
        for node in range(self.size):
            if not self.marked[node]:
                continue
            self.potential[node] -= self.distances[target] - self.distances[node]
        return True

    def pareto_frontier(self, source, target, max_flow=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.size
        self.distances = [4294967295] * self.size
        self.parents = [-1] * self.size
        self.parent_edges = [-1] * self.size
        self.marked = [False] * self.size

        total_weight = 0
        last_weight = -1

                break
            bottleneck = max_flow - current_flow

            while node != source:

                node = self.parents[node]

            last_weight = reduced_cost

    def min_cost_flow(self, source, target, max_flow=4294967295):
        return self.pareto_frontier(source, target, max_flow)[-1]

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MinimumCostFlow {
        private int size;
        private List<int[]> edgesInfo;
        private List<List<Edge>> adjacency;

        public MinimumCostFlow(int nodeCount) {
            this.size = nodeCount;
            this.edgesInfo = new ArrayList<>();
            this.adjacency = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
                adjacency.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        public void connect(int src, int dst, int capacity, int weight) {
            int idx = edgesInfo.size();
            edgesInfo.add(new int[]{src, adjacency.get(src).size()});
            adjacency.get(src).add(new Edge(dst, adjacency.get(dst).size(), capacity, weight));
            adjacency.get(dst).add(new Edge(src, adjacency.get(src).size() - 1, 0, -weight));
        }

        public static class Link {
            public int origin;
            public int destination;
            public int capacity;
            public int flow;
            public int weight;

            public Link(int origin, int destination, int capacity, int flow, int weight) {
                this.origin = origin;
                this.destination = destination;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.weight = weight;
            }
        }

        public Link retrieveLink(int index) {
            int[] info = edgesInfo.get(index);
            int source = info[0];
            int pos = info[1];
            Edge forward = adjacency.get(source).get(pos);
            Edge backward = adjacency.get(forward.destination).get(forward.reverse);
            return new Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight);
        }

        public List<Link> allLinks() {
            List<Link> output = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int idx = 0; idx < edgesInfo.size(); idx++) {
                int[] info = edgesInfo.get(idx);
                int source = info[0];
                int pos = info[1];
                Edge forward = adjacency.get(source).get(pos);
                Edge backward = adjacency.get(forward.destination).get(forward.reverse);
                output.add(new Link(source, forward.destination, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.weight));
            }
            return output;
        }

        private int[] distances;
        private int[] parents;
        private int[] parentEdges;
        private boolean[] marked;
        private int[] potential;

        private boolean potentialUpdate(int source, int target) {
            distances = new int[size];
            parents = new int[size];
            parentEdges = new int[size];
            marked = new boolean[size];
            Arrays.fill(distances, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(parents, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentEdges, -1);
            Arrays.fill(marked, false);

            PriorityQueue<int[]> queue = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            distances[source] = 0;
            queue.offer(new int[]{0, source});

            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int[] currentEntry = queue.poll();
                int current = currentEntry[1];
                if (marked[current]) continue;
                marked[current] = true;
                if (current == target) break;

                for (int idx = 0; idx < adjacency.get(current).size(); idx++) {
                    Edge edge = adjacency.get(current).get(idx);
                    if (marked[edge.destination] || edge.capacity == 0) continue;
                    int adjustedCost = edge.weight - potential[edge.destination] + potential[current];
                    if (distances[edge.destination] > distances[current] + adjustedCost) {
                        distances[edge.destination] = distances[current] + adjustedCost;
                        parents[edge.destination] = current;
                        parentEdges[edge.destination] = idx;
                        queue.offer(new int[]{distances[edge.destination], edge.destination});
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!marked[target]) return false;

            for (int node = 0; node < size; node++) {
                if (!marked[node]) continue;
                potential[node] -= distances[target] - distances[node];
            }
            return true;
        }

        public List<int[]> paretoFrontier(int source, int target, int maxFlow) {
            potential = new int[size];
            distances = new int[size];
            parents = new int[size];
            parentEdges = new int[size];
            marked = new boolean[size];
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);

            int currentFlow = 0;
            int totalWeight = 0;
            int lastWeight = -1;
            List<int[]> frontier = new ArrayList<>();
            frontier.add(new int[]{currentFlow, totalWeight});

            while (currentFlow < maxFlow) {
                if (!potentialUpdate(source, target)) break;

                int bottleneck = maxFlow - currentFlow;
                int node = target;
                while (node != source) {
                    Edge edge = adjacency.get(parents[node]).get(parentEdges[node]);
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, edge.capacity);
                    node = parents[node];
                }

                node = target;
                while (node != source) {
                    Edge edge = adjacency.get(parents[node]).get(parentEdges[node]);
                    edge.capacity -= bottleneck;
                    Edge backwardEdge = adjacency.get(node).get(edge.reverse);
                    backwardEdge.capacity += bottleneck;
                    node = parents[node];
                }

                int reducedCost = -potential[source];
                currentFlow += bottleneck;
                totalWeight += bottleneck * reducedCost;

                if (lastWeight == reducedCost && !frontier.isEmpty()) {
                    frontier.remove(frontier.size() - 1);
                }
                frontier.add(new int[]{currentFlow, totalWeight});
                lastWeight = reducedCost;
            }
            return frontier;
        }

        public int[] minCostFlow(int source, int target, int maxFlow) {
            List<int[]> frontier = paretoFrontier(source, target, maxFlow);
            return frontier.get(frontier.size() - 1);
        }

        public static class Edge {
            public int destination;
            public int reverse;
            public int capacity;
            public int weight;

            public Edge(int destination, int reverse, int capacity, int weight) {
                this.destination = destination;
                this.reverse = reverse;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.weight = weight;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int a1 = scanner.nextInt();
        int a2 = scanner.nextInt();
        int a3 = scanner.nextInt();
        int b1 = scanner.nextInt();
        int b2 = scanner.nextInt();
        int b3 = scanner.nextInt();

        MinimumCostFlow g = new MinimumCostFlow(8);
        g.connect(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.connect(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.connect(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.connect(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.connect(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.connect(6, 7, b3, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.connect(i, j, Integer.MAX_VALUE, cost);
            }
        }

        int[] result = g.minCostFlow(0, 7, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        int ans1 = result[1];
        int ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
